package.title: Member context menus, owner kick, self-leave with archived membership

specification.intent: Header member avatars get context menus: another user -> «Добавить в контакты» (only when not already a contact) + «Удалить из чата» (chat owner only, backend-enforced); the own avatar -> «Удалиться из чата» turning the chat into a READ-ONLY archive entry for the leaver (stays dimmed in the list, history readable, no live WS pushes, writes 403, re-add reactivates). Owner-kick is a hard membership delete (the kicked user loses the chat entirely). Migration 010 adds chat_members.left_at; WS broadcast fan-out filters archived members; the legacy instant-kick avatar click (currently erroring via unsupported removeUsers) is replaced.

requirements.title: Archived membership: migration 010, leave/kick endpoints, left_at exposure, reactivation
requirements.description: ChatMember.left_at (DateTime tz, nullable; NULL = active) + migration 010_chat_leave (segment roundtrip test backend/tests/integration/test_migration_010_chat_leave_segment.py per the 009 pattern: scratch SQLite, create_all -> stamp head -> downgrade -1 -> upgrade head, inspector-asserted; alembic heads == 010_chat_leave; full chain stays the compose-PostgreSQL path). POST /api/v1/chats/{chat_id}/leave: member row -> left_at=now, closes the caller's sockets for the chat (user-scoped close), 204; repeat on archived row -> idempotent 204; never-member -> 403 chat_membership_required; anonymous 401. DELETE /api/v1/chats/{chat_id}/members/{user_id}: owner-only (chat_owner_required 403; chat_not_found 404; member row absent 404), hard-deletes the row, closes the kicked user's sockets (user-scoped), 204; kicked user loses the chat (absent from GET /chats, WS connect refused by the existing membership guard); re-add after kick = fresh row; re-add after LEAVE reactivates (left_at -> NULL) keeping the idempotent 201 add semantics and the implicit contact capture on both resolution paths; the re-add actor must be an ACTIVE member. The GET /chats LIST carries caller-relative left_at: datetime | null per row (ChatResponse.left_at additive None-default; list_chats passes it explicitly in the field-by-field construction — the is_dm precedent; the single-chat GET /{id} keeps left_at null by design — no membership context, documented). Router order: both new routes placed safely against the int /{chat_id} routes.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-01 (leave keeps the chat for history, dimmed; kick removes entirely; owner-only kick, anyone may leave, archived = read-only)

requirements.title: Read/write guard split and archived-filtered WS broadcast
requirements.description: Membership guards split by intent, enforced via a new ChatService.require_active_member called from the entry points the write-set owns: the WS send branch (ws/router.py), the REST message-create and reaction-toggle endpoints (endpoints/chats.py), add_member, leave, the bot-run membership check (services/bot.py require_member -> active variant) and the chat-scoped file-upload check (services/files.py) — guards only, no behaviour change for active members; services/messages.py stays untouched (its row-exists _require_member is the READ side). READ paths (GET chat, GET messages, GET members, WS connect incl. initial history and pagination) accept active OR archived; WRITE paths reject archived with 403 chat_membership_required (WS send: explicit error, no broadcast) — every rejection pinned. mark_read becomes a NO-OP for archived rows (a 403 would break archived history — the history path calls it inline). The WS hub gains per-socket user identity (the StoriesHub precedent), a user-scoped close (close_user_chat) for leave/kick, and an active-membership fan-out filter (message/reaction/chat_deleted events): pinned by an INTEGRATION-LEVEL TWO-SOCKET test (one active + one archived client in the same chat, the test_stories_ws.py multi-client precedent) — the active client receives, the archived one is silent; kick/leave close ONLY the affected user's socket. Delete chat stays owner-only by owner_id regardless of the owner's archived state (require_owned unchanged).
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-01 (messages must stop arriving after leave; history stays readable)

requirements.title: Frontend logic: supported removeUsers, leaveChat, left_at mapping, injected contact-adder
requirements.description: ChatInfo gains leftAt?: string | null AND owner_id?: number (src/utils/types.ts, no api import — the owner-only menu item needs owner_id, which toChatInfo currently drops). ChatsPort: removeUsers becomes supported (DELETE /${chatId}/members/${userId} + csrf per user id) and leaveChat(chatId) joins (POST /${chatId}/leave + csrf). toChatInfo maps left_at -> leftAt (absent/null -> undefined) AND owner_id -> owner_id. Controller: removeUsersFromChat(users, chatId) replaces the private deleteChatUsers error path AND removes the legacy user.onClick instant-kick wiring in getChatUsers (the forEach dies in this wave); leaveChat(chatId) -> port call, close the chat socket WITHOUT reconnect, clear selectedChat, refetch chats; addContact(userId) and refreshContacts() delegate to ONE injected integration object: module-level setContactsIntegration({addContact, refreshContacts}) with noop defaults in features/chats/controller.ts (the seam lives in the CONSUMER — a setter in contacts would force a cross-feature import and fail the guard); features/index.ts wires it with the real contacts controller beside setChatOpener — the ONLY cross-feature seam. refreshContacts exists because the contacts slice is only fetched by the contacts page today; the ChatPage CDM calls it so the conditional contact item works on cold /messenger entry.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-01 (menu actions need kick/leave/add-contact through controllers)

requirements.title: Frontend UI: header context menus, dimmed archived card, hidden composer
requirements.description: Messenger header avatar click opens a Modal context menu (contacts-menu precedent; escapeHtml builder) — the legacy instant-kick onClick wiring is already gone after wave 2. Visibility matrix: another user's avatar -> «Добавить в контакты» only when the id is NOT in contactIds (client-side check against the contacts slice), «Удалить из чата» only when meId === ownerId; the viewer's OWN avatar (id === meId) -> «Удалиться из чата»; archived chats show NO menu AND hide the + add-user header button (messenger.hbs/messenger.ts wiring at :468-473); every menu has «Отмена». New Messenger props: contactIds, meId, ownerId, onAddContact, onKickUser, onLeaveChat (page-supplied; components stay controller-free). ChatPage CDM additionally calls ChatsController.refreshContacts() (the injected refresh populates the slice on cold /messenger entry) and the withStore mapper supplies contactIds (contacts cast idiom), meId, ownerId; callbacks wired to the controller. chatListUser renders the archived modifier (dimmed card) driven by leftAt (component + hbs + chat-list-user.scss, no comments in scss); the composer is hidden for archived chats while the history list stays scrollable (messenger.hbs conditional). Docs: NEXT.md record + progress_log entry on top incl. the still-open follow-up registry (legacy «@-поиск» comment sweep).
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-01 (menus on messenger__chat-users-container icons; dimmed archive card)

specification.goal: Member avatars become a management surface: add contacts, owner kicks, self-leave into a read-only dimmed archive — with WS semantics to match.
constraints: Layers only downward; guard-architecture --all --strict stays green; components never import features/controllers; the ONLY cross-feature seam is src/features/index.ts (setChatOpener + setContactsIntegration wiring).
Migration 010 is additive (chat_members.left_at); alembic heads becomes 010_chat_leave (verify:backend pins); the segment roundtrip test proves both directions on scratch SQLite; never touch 001-009.
All new endpoints behind get_current_user; anonymous 401 pinned; kick is owner-only (403 pinned); leave is any-member; archived writes 403 pinned; kicked users lose access entirely.
Menu content HTML only through the escapeHtml builder; XSS test on display_name; double braces elsewhere.

slice modules untouched (the contacts slice is deliberately POPULATED via the injected refreshContacts — no module edit); utils/Store.ts NOT edited; existing suites green; counts grow from the real bases at the attempt line (mocha 423 / pytest 218 modulo the 4 documented Windows ingestion failures).
nonGoals: WS push of member-list changes (menus/avatars refresh on next fetch)
a rejoin button (re-add via the existing add-user modal reactivates)
ownership transfer when the owner leaves
deleting the chat on leave; bulk member operations
changes to the contacts page menu (stays as built)

criteria.title: Leave/kick endpoints, left_at exposure, reactivation proven by pytest
criteria.statement: Migration 010 adds chat_members.left_at (nullable, NULL = active), proven by the segment roundtrip test, heads == 010_chat_leave; POST /chats/{id}/leave: member 204, repeat 204 idempotent, never-member 403, anonymous 401, user-scoped socket close; DELETE /chats/{id}/members/{user_id}: owner 204, non-owner 403, no-row 404, unknown chat 404, kicked user loses the chat (GET /chats absent, WS connect refused); the GET /chats LIST carries caller-relative left_at (null for active) via explicit field-by-field pass (the single-chat GET keeps null by design — documented); re-add after kick = fresh row, re-add after leave reactivates (left_at NULL) with unchanged idempotent-201 + contact capture, re-add actor must be active; all pytest-pinned.

criteria.title: Read/write guard split + archived-filtered broadcast proven by pytest
criteria.statement: Guards split via ChatService.require_active_member enforced at the WS send branch, the REST message-create and reaction-toggle endpoints, add_member, leave, the bot-run check (services/bot.py) and the chat-scoped file-upload check (services/files.py): READ paths (GET chat/messages/members, WS connect + initial history + pagination) accept active OR archived; WRITE paths reject archived with 403 / WS error — every rejection pinned incl. archived bot-run and file-upload; mark_read is a NO-OP for archived (inline history call must not break); the hub gains per-socket identity, user-scoped close and an active-membership fan-out filter pinned by an INTEGRATION-LEVEL TWO-SOCKET test (active receives, archived silent; kick/leave close only the affected user's socket); delete-chat stays owner-only by owner_id regardless of archived state.

securityGates.statement: All new endpoints behind get_current_user (anonymous 401 pinned); kick is owner-only (chat_owner_required 403 pinned, non-owner cannot remove anyone); leave only self; archived members cannot write on ANY path — WS send, REST message POST, reaction toggle, add member, bot run, chat-scoped file upload all 403 (pinned) — though they read; kicked users lose WS access by the existing membership guard; the broadcast filter never leaks events to archived members (two-socket pin).
Menu content HTML built exclusively through the escapeHtml-based builder; a <script> display_name renders as text (XSS test); double braces everywhere else in new templates.
